title: Metallothionein as a biomarker of aquatic contamination in fish: An in silico and in vitro approach using zebrafish as experimental model organism.
authors: Luz, Jessica Zablocki da; Gorshkov, Vladimir; Miranda, Renata Rank; Souza, Tugstenio Lima de; Rodrigues Ribeiro, Lucas; Duan, Xiaoyu; Huang, Yuyue; Oliveira Ribeiro, Ciro Alberto de; Xu, Elvis Genbo; Kjeldsen, Frank; Filipak Neto, Francisco
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过分子对接评估金属离子与锌指蛋白结合亲和力，并实验检测斑马鱼金属硫蛋白诱导，虽涉及蛋白-金属离子结合而非蛋白-DNA互作，且无AI/物理模拟方法，仅部分相关。
abstract: Human activities contaminate aquatic ecosystems with chemicals like metals and pesticides. Fish, sensitive to pollution, are key toxicological models. Metallothionein (Mt) expression, a biomarker for metal contamination, varies depending on the chemical exposure. This study investigated differences in metal affinity for Zn(2+) binding sites of proteins and Mt induction by the insecticides dichlorvos (DDPV) and deltamethrin (DTM) in Danio rerio. First, D. rerio Zn-binding protein structures with different cell functions were used to evaluate the difference between the binding scores of five metals with the binding site with highest affinity for Zn(2+) through molecular docking and from there to infer the most potent inducers. Cadmium ion was found to have the highest binding score mean for the selected proteins (Cd(2+)>Cu(2+)>Pb(2+)>Mn(2+)>Cu(+)>Hg(2+)), and, thus, cadmium chloride (CdCl(2)) was used as a positive control for Mt induction in D. rerio larvae. D. rerio embryos were exposed to sublethal concentrations of Cd (100 mug L(-1)), DDPV (1 mg L(-1)), and DTM (0.01 mug L(-1)) up to 96 h post-fertilization (hpf). Larvae exposed to Cd and DDPV showed increased Mt levels, whereas DTM exposure had no effect. Proteomic analyses suggest that Mt induction in D. rerio larvae exposed to Cd follows a distinct mechanism from DDPV exposure. Enrichment analysis supports a possible link between DDPV exposure and oxidative stress-induced Mt expression. In contrast, Cd-induced Mt expression likely involves metal transcription factor activation by Zn(2+). These differences in responsiveness highlight the need for careful consideration when using Mt as a biomarker of metal contamination.
abstract_zh: 人类活动通过金属和农药等化学物质污染水生生态系统。鱼类对污染敏感，是关键的毒理学模型。金属硫蛋白（Metallothionein, Mt）表达作为金属污染的生物标志物，其水平因化学暴露而异。本研究探讨了斑马鱼（Danio rerio）中蛋白质Zn(2+)结合位点的金属亲和力差异，以及杀虫剂敌敌畏（dichlorvos, DDPV）和溴氰菊酯（deltamethrin, DTM）对Mt诱导的影响。首先，利用具有不同细胞功能的斑马鱼Zn结合蛋白结构，通过分子对接（molecular docking）评估五种金属与Zn(2+)最高亲和力结合位点的结合分数差异，并据此推断最有效的诱导剂。结果发现，镉离子在所选蛋白质中的平均结合分数最高（Cd(2+)>Cu(2+)>Pb(2+)>Mn(2+)>Cu(+)>Hg(2+)），因此，氯化镉（cadmium chloride, CdCl(2)）被用作斑马鱼幼虫Mt诱导的阳性对照。斑马鱼胚胎在受精后96小时（hpf）内暴露于亚致死浓度的Cd（100 μg L(-1)）、DDPV（1 mg L(-1)）和DTM（0.01 μg L(-1)）。暴露于Cd和DDPV的幼虫显示Mt水平升高，而DTM暴露无影响。蛋白质组学分析表明，暴露于Cd的斑马鱼幼虫中Mt诱导机制与DDPV暴露不同。富集分析支持DDPV暴露与氧化应激诱导的Mt表达之间可能存在关联。相比之下，Cd诱导的Mt表达可能涉及Zn(2+)激活金属转录因子。这些响应差异凸显了在使用Mt作为金属污染生物标志物时需要谨慎考虑。
